Combining V6 power, sporty styling, and midsize SUV practicality, this Chevrolet Blazer is an excellent choice for drivers seeking a stylish and powerful SUV with plenty of everyday comfort.

The used 2010 Acura RDX Sport Utility 4D brings turbocharged performance and all-weather confidence to the SUV class. A rear limited-slip differential and center limited-slip differential support traction, while full-time 4WD provides confident power delivery across changing road conditions.
